name: Signature library evidence
summary: Evidence workflow for a digital-signature library: functional acceptance, known-answer vectors, performance budget and an attack-assessment table with explicit uncertainty.

panels.title: What this project does not test

controls.label: Show superseded runs
controls.description: Superseded runs stay in the record; this only changes what is listed.

evidenceRequirements: Every metric carries a definition of how it was measured.
Every run records artifact version, test definition version, criteria version, environment, tool versions, parameters and seeds.
Every completed run has an evidence record with a manifest hash.
Findings carry at least one deterministic check or a named reviewer before they are labelled above Estimate.

approvalGates.description: Each acceptance-criteria version is approved by the project owner before runs are judged against it.
Experiments run only under an approved, numbered protocol.
Proposed (non-baseline) tests need execution approval before they consume budget.
Recommendations are accepted by the customer owner, never auto-applied.
A finding is resolved only with a linked passing retest and a reviewer decision.
Conductor tasks that exceed a budget threshold pause at a checkpoint.

disclaimers: Results apply only to the artifact versions and test definitions listed. They are not a certification and say nothing about untested attacks or other code paths.
Sample data: every number shown for this project is illustrative and marked as such.

name: Static structural analysis
summary: Evidence workflow for a load-bearing part: geometry, material and load-case artifacts; solver runs with mesh-convergence checks; safety factors against stated acceptance criteria.

panels.title: What this project does not test

controls.label: Load case
controls.description: Filters metrics to one load case.

evidenceRequirements: Every stress value states the solver, version, mesh and load case it came from.
A result is reported as converged only when the convergence criterion in the test definition is met.

approvalGates.description: Safety-factor thresholds are approved by the project owner.
Design-change recommendations are accepted by the customer owner.
A finding is resolved only with a passing retest on the revised geometry.

disclaimers: This is an analysis aid, not a design sign-off. A qualified engineer must review before any part is released.
Sample data: values are illustrative and are not measurements of a real part.

name: Dispute preparation
summary: Evidence workflow for a contract dispute: chronology from documents, fact checks against sources, fictional-authority analysis and an argument rehearsal panel.

controls.label: Confidentiality
controls.description: Set in project settings; shown here for awareness.

evidenceRequirements: Every fact in the chronology links to a document location.
Every authority is labelled 'Sample authority, not a real case'.

approvalGates.description: Revised arguments are approved by the responsible lawyer.
Confidentiality and membership changes need the owner's approval.

disclaimers: Not legal advice. The rehearsal panel is a preparation exercise, not a prediction of the outcome.
All authorities in sample data are fictional and labelled as such.
